arxiv-1605-05904.title: Re-ranking Object Proposals for Object Detection in Automatic Driving
arxiv-1605-05904.creator: Zhun Zhong, Mingyi Lei, Shaozi Li, Jianping Fan
arxiv-1605-05904.description: Abstract Object detection often suffers from a plenty of bootless proposals, selecting high quality proposals remains a great challenge. In this paper, we propose a semantic, class-specific approach to re-rank object proposals, which can consistently improve the recall performance even with less proposals.

arxiv-2112-06738.title: Free reflection multiarrangements and quasi-invariants
arxiv-2112-06738.creator: T. Abe, N. Enomoto, M. Feigin, M. Yoshinaga
arxiv-2112-06738.description: Abstract . To a complex reflection arrangement with an invariant multiplicity function one can relate the space of logarithmic vector fields and the space of quasi-invariants, which are both modules over invariant polynomials. We establish a close relation between these modules. Berest–Chalykh freeness results for the module of quasi-invariants lead to new free complex reflection multiarrangements. K.

arxiv-2205-12354.title: Optimal Entanglement Distribution using Satellite Based Quantum Networks
arxiv-2205-12354.creator: Nitish K. Panigrahy 2 , Prajit Dhara 3 , Don Towsley 4 , Saikat Guha 3 and Leandros Tassiulas 2
arxiv-2205-12354.description: Abstract Recent technological advancements in satellite based quantum communication has made it a promising technology for realizing global scale quantum networks. Due to better loss distance scaling compared to ground based fiber communication, satellite quantum communication can distribute high quality quantum entanglements among ground stations that are geographically separated at very long distances.

arxiv-2302-04399.title: Balanced Allocations in Batches: The Tower of Two Choices Full version of a paper appearing in SPAA 2023.
arxiv-2302-04399.creator: Dimitrios Los, Thomas Sauerwald
arxiv-2302-04399.description: Abstract In the balanced allocation framework, the goal is to allocate m m balls into n n bins, so as to minimize the gap (difference of maximum to average load). The One-Choice process allocates each ball to a bin sampled independently and uniformly at random.

arxiv-2303-07720.title: Polarized proton structure in the resonance region
arxiv-2303-07720.creator: A. N. Hiller Blin, V. I. Mokeev
arxiv-2303-07720.description: Abstract In view of the precise data available on inclusive polarized electron scattering off polarized proton targets in the nucleon resonance excitation region, we compare these results with the coherent sum of resonant contributions to the polarized structure function g 1 g_{1} and virtual photon asymmetry A 1 A_{1} .

arxiv-2305-19512.title: Fine-grained Text Style Transfer with Diffusion-Based Language Models
arxiv-2305-19512.creator: Yiwei Lyu, Tiange Luo, Jiacheng Shi, Todd C. Hollon, Honglak Lee
arxiv-2305-19512.description: Abstract Diffusion probabilistic models have shown great success in generating high-quality images controllably, and researchers have tried to utilize this controllability into text generation domain. Previous works on diffusion-based language models have shown that they can be trained without external knowledge (such as pre-trained weights) and still achieve stable performance and controllability.

arxiv-2311-08742.title: sQueeze: Accelerated Quantum Pulse Schedules
arxiv-2311-08742.creator: Lilian Hunt, Alan Robertson
arxiv-2311-08742.description: Abstract . Quantum devices in the Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum (NISQ) era are limited by high error rates and short decoherence times. Typically, compiler optimisations have provided solutions at the gate level. Alternatively, we exploit the finest level of quantum control and introduce a set of pulse level quantum compiler optimisations: sQueeze.

arxiv-2401-00665.title: An algorithm for estimating the crossing number of dense graphs, and continuous analogs of the crossing and rectilinear crossing numbers
arxiv-2401-00665.creator: Oriol Solé-Pi
arxiv-2401-00665.description: Abstract We present a deterministic n 2 + o ⁡ ( 1 ) n^{2+o(1)} -time algorithm that approximates the crossing number of any graph G G of order n n up to an additive error of o ⁡ ( n 4 ) o(n^{4}) .

arxiv-2404-09160.title: Topological rainbow trapping and broadband piezoelectric energy harvesting of acoustic waves in gradient phononic crystals with coupled interfaces
arxiv-2404-09160.creator: Xiao-Lei Tang, Xue-Qian Zhang, Tian-Xue Ma, Miso Kim, Yue-Sheng Wang
arxiv-2404-09160.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Xiao-Lei Tang, Xue-Qian Zhang, Tian-Xue Ma, Miso Kim, Yue-Sheng Wang. Topological phononic crystals (PCs) offer an innovative method for manipulating acoustic or elastic waves. In this study, we introduce the gradient PC structures with coupled interfaces, specifically designed to achieve topological rainbow trapping and broadband acoustic energy harvesting. By leveraging the geometric symmetry of PC unit cells, we merge two PCs with distinct topological phases to create coupled topological interfaces.

arxiv-2406-01799.title: Online Control in Population Dynamics
arxiv-2406-01799.creator: Noah Golowich, Elad Hazan, Zhou Lu, Dhruv Rohatgi, Y. Jennifer Sun
arxiv-2406-01799.description: Abstract The study of population dynamics originated with early sociological works but has since extended into many fields, including biology, epidemiology, evolutionary game theory, and economics. Most studies on population dynamics focus on the problem of prediction rather than control .

arxiv-2406-15538.title: Model-Based Generation of Representative Rear-End Crash Scenarios Across the Full Severity Range Using Pre-Crash Data
arxiv-2406-15538.creator: Jian Wu, Carol Flannagan, Ulrich Sander, Jonas Bärgman
arxiv-2406-15538.description: Abstract Generating representative rear-end crash scenarios is crucial for safety assessments of Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) and Automated Driving systems (ADS). However, existing methods for scenario generation face challenges such as limited and biased in-depth crash data and difficulties in validation.

arxiv-2502-00502.title: Spherically symmetric and static black bounces with multiple horizons, throats, and anti-throats in four dimensions
arxiv-2502-00502.creator: Manuel E. Rodrigues, Marcos V. de S. Silva
arxiv-2502-00502.description: Abstract Black bounce spacetimes usually arise from the Simpson-Visser regularization method. This type of metric presents a wormhole throat inside an event horizon. In this paper, we presented new classes of black bounce spacetime solutions, which have multiple horizons, throats, and anti-throats. These solutions are variants of black holes and wormholes, based on modifications of the Schwarzschild and Simpson-Visser metrics.

arxiv-2511-22072.title: A Multi-View Multi-Timescale Hypergraph-Empowered Spatiotemporal Framework for EV Charging Forecasting
arxiv-2511-22072.creator: Jinhao Li and Hao Wang
arxiv-2511-22072.description: Abstract Accurate electric vehicle (EV) charging demand forecasting is essential for stable grid operation and proactive EV participation in electricity market. Existing forecasting methods, particularly those based on graph neural networks, are often limited to modeling pairwise relationships between stations, failing to capture the complex, group-wise dynamics inherent in urban charging networks.

plos-pone-0003548.description: PLOS ONE research article. Pre-existing immunity to human adenovirus serotype 5 (Ad5) is common in the general population. Bypassing pre-existing immunity could maximize Ad5 vaccine efficacy. Vaccination by the intramuscular (I.M.), nasal (I.N.) or oral (P.O.) route with Ad5 expressing Ebola Zaire glycopro

pmc-10596912.title: What health risk factors are brought by the most popular Lithuanian influencers in social networks?
pmc-10596912.creator: R Basijokas, D Austys
pmc-10596912.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundConsidering that content created by influencers in social networks might act as risk factor to health, we aimed to assess the prevalence of lifestyle-related risk factors in posts published by Lithuanian influencers on Facebook and Instagram.Material and methodsAll publicly available posts created by 12 most popular Lithuanian influencers on Facebook or Instagram between 1 Jan and 31 Dec of 2022 were included. The content analysis of the posts was performed in the structured manner.

pmc-10748179.title: Morphologies of Comb-like Polyacrylic Acid/Polyacrylate Copolymers as Functions of the Degree of Derivatization with n-C22H45 Side Chains
pmc-10748179.creator: Tomoya Okada, Mizuho Ishii, Harumi Sato, Go Matsuba
pmc-10748179.description: Polymers with crystallizable side chains have numerous applications, and their properties depend on their crystal morphologies and phase separation. Structural analysis on a wide spatial scale plays an important role in controlling the thermal properties and higher-order structures of these polymers.

pmc-11313242.title: Comparison of Quantitative and Qualitative EDXRF Analysis for Provenance Study of Archaeological Ceramics
pmc-11313242.creator: Maja Gajic-Kvascev, Velibor Andric, Radmila Jancic-Heinemann, Ognjen Mladenovic, Aleksandar Bulatovic, P J Sánchez-Soto
pmc-11313242.description: The most common scientific analysis of archaeological ceramics aims to determine the raw material source and/or production technology. Scientists and archaeologists widely use XRF-based techniques as a tool in a provenance study. After conducting XRF analysis, the results are often analyzed using multivariate analysis in addition to interpretation and conclusions.

pmc-11354782.title: Hydrogen Bond Strengthens Acceptor Group: The Curious Case of the C–H···O=C Bond
pmc-11354782.creator: Kingshuk Basu, Esther S. Brielle, Isaiah T. Arkin
pmc-11354782.description: An H-bond involves the sharing of a hydrogen atom between an electronegative atom to which it is covalently bound (the donor) and another electronegative atom serving as an acceptor. Such bonds represent a critically important geometrical force in biological macromolecules and, as such, have been characterized extensively.

pmc-11712249.title: Computerized testing to detect cognitive decline in biomarker‐confirmed Alzheimer’s disease: Longitudinal findings from the ARMADA study
pmc-11712249.creator: Roos J Jutten, Emily Ho, Tatiana Karpouzian‐Rogers, Carol A. Van Hulle, Hiroko H Dodge, Cindy J. Nowinski, Richard C. Gershon, Sandra Weintraub, Dorene M Rentz
pmc-11712249.description: BackgroundThe National Institutes of Health Toolbox for Assessment of Neurological and Behavioral Function (NIHTB) was developed to address the need for a brief yet comprehensive instrument to facilitate more uniform assessment in large‐scale research studies. Here, we investigated whether the cognitive measures of the NIHTB detect cognitive decline in biomarker‐confirmed Alzheimer’s disease (AD).

pmc-12442233.title: Antibiotic prescribing for children for acute conditions in public primary care clinics in Singapore: a retrospective cohort database study
pmc-12442233.creator: Sky Wei Chee Koh, Vivien Min Er Lee, Si Hui Low, Anna Szuecs, Victor Weng Keong Loh, Meena Sundram, Linus Kee Loon Chua, José M Valderas, Li Yang Hsu
pmc-12442233.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Objectives: Data on primary care antibiotic prescription practices for children in Southeast Asia, which are essential for policy, quality improvement and patient safety, are lacking. We aimed to describe this gap and to benchmark prescription practices against international standards. Methods: Antibiotic prescriptions for children (age <18 years) who visited six public primary care clinics in Singapore between 2018 and 2021 were extracted and categorized according to the World Health Organization Access, Watch, Reserve (WHO AWaRe) classification.

pmc-12589477.title: Metabolic profile and bioactivity of the rhizome oil of Kaempferia parviflora from Eastern India
pmc-12589477.creator: Rajashree Panigrahi, Sameer Ranjan Sahoo, Biswabhusan Dash, Reena Parida
pmc-12589477.description: Kaempferia parviflora (black ginger) is a tropical edible medicinal plant with valuable rhizome product used in the pharmaceutical industry for wide beneficial health effects in curing various diseases. The current study aims to analyse compounds present in rhizome oil using Gas Chromatography-Time of Flight-Mass Spectrometry (GC-TOF-MS). Hydro distillation was used to extract the essential oil from the plant rhizomes.

pmc-12750288.title: Addressing Migrant Worker Housing—From Structural Neglect to Strategic Policy Action
pmc-12750288.creator: Schawanya K Rattanapitoon, Natnapa H Padchasuwan, Nav La, Nathkapach K Rattanapitoon
pmc-12750288.description: authors rightly underscore the multidimensional consequences of substandard living conditions for migrant workers—ranging from heightened infectious disease transmission to psychological distress and cumulative occupational risks. This intersectional perspective reflects the evolving understanding of the “social determinants of occupational health,” where work-related exposures do not end at the factory gate but extend into the domestic sphere [2].

pmc-13099360.title: Community-acquired hypervirulent Klebsiella pneumoniae meningitis in Canada: A case report
pmc-13099360.creator: Jamie Ghossein, Antoine Tilmont, Jasper Ho, Rayyan Kinsara, Charlie Tan, Yingming Amy Chen, Emily Tam, Alberto Goffi
pmc-13099360.description: IntroductionHypervirulent Klebsiella pneumoniae has emerged as a cause of fulminant metastatic infections, particularly prevalent amongst patients in Asia, but increasing in many areas worldwide. This report describes a fatal case of community-acquired Klebsiella pneumoniae in Canada causing meningitis complicated by several neurological complications.

pmc-13285107.title: Surgical and hormonal gender-affirming care: cross-domain determinants and artificial intelligence-enabled expansion
pmc-13285107.creator: Mehek Sharma, Vikram Sharma, Gianluca De Leo
pmc-13285107.description: Gender-affirming surgery (GAS) and gender-affirming hormone therapy (GAHT) and are evidence-based components of care that support the health and well-being of transgender and gender-diverse (TGD) individuals, with extensive evidence linking them to reduced suicidality, improved mental health, and quality of life.

pmc-13534616.title: Computational design, synthesis and biological evaluation of novel pyridinone derivatives as NNRTIs
pmc-13534616.creator: Niloofar Movahednia, Ali Ramazani, Afshin fassihi, Pouria Shirvani, Dominique Schols
pmc-13534616.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The emergence of resistance against first-generation non-nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitors (NNRTIs) necessitates the development of novel scaffolds with improved antiviral efficacy. In this study, a series of pyridinone derivatives were designed and synthesized as potential NNRTIs. The antiviral evaluation against wild-type HIV-1 in MT-4 cells revealed that most of the compounds displayed limited or no activity, often accompanied by cytotoxic effects.

uslaw-usc-t33-s45.title: 33 U.S.C. § 45 — Swan Creek, Toledo, Ohio
uslaw-usc-t33-s45.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t33-s45.description: United States Code, Title 33 (Navigation And Navigable Waters); Chapter 1 (Navigable Waters Generally); Subchapter II (Waters Declared Nonnavigable: Change Of Name). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Swan Creek, a stream lying within the limits of the city of Toledo, State of Ohio, is declared to be not a navigable waterway of the United States within the meaning of the laws enacted.
